This root is often used with nouns, adjectives, and indeclinables to form verbs from them, somewhat like the English affixes ‘en’ or ‘(i) fy’, in the sense of ‘making a person or thing to be what it previously is not’; e. g. kṛṣṇīkṛ to make that which is not already black, black, i. e. blacken; so śvetīkṛ to whiten; ghanīkṛ to solidify; viralīkṛ to rarefy &c. &c.
